No failing file is in REQ-465's change set. Three UatPreflightLocalDepsTest tests fail deterministically on this Windows host (the scenario directory scan rejects the c:/Users/... tmp path; setting UAT_PF_BASH to Git bash does not change it). The other failures are load-sensitive and pass when re-run in isolation (PlatformScopeNotConferredTest 401; DefinitionsTest and MigrationRolloutTest tenant clone 'tenant_id has already been taken'; TestParallelWatchdogOrphanTest 40 s pipe timeout at loadavg 12.8). (3) REVIEWER issue 4 is still open: req465_meridian_loan_distinct_from_test.exs calls A.sandbox_auto!() in setup, a global Repo mode flip with no on_exit restore. The escalation residual (escalate-disburse-loan-to-credit-director does not name l2-approval or committee-vote-director) is confirmed, correctly documented, and is a BA decision (GH #2386). It is not a technical failure of this validation, but it blocks done.

issues.description: The full suite is not green on this host. scripts/test_parallel.sh exited 1 (6 failures) and mix letflow.check.test exited 1 (4 failures). No failing file is in the REQ-465 change set. Three UatPreflightLocalDepsTest failures are deterministic on this Windows host. The other failures are load-sensitive and pass in isolation. No origin/main baseline was run, so pre-existence is unproven. A green run on Linux CI is required before merge.

REVIEWER step-04 issue 1 (must correct in this PR) is still open. The regulatory fixture description (test/fixtures/qa/meridian_regulatory_compliance_review_process_definition.json, description field) still says ceo-override's findings-sign-off entry is inert because findings-sign-off is reached only through its timeout edge. REVIEWER states that premise is false. ELIXIR-DEV must correct the text (no list, edge or test change) and the copy in step-02. I did not re-derive the edges.

REVIEWER step-04 issue 4 is still open. test/letflow/engine/req465_meridian_loan_distinct_from_test.exs calls A.sandbox_auto!() in setup, a global Repo sandbox mode flip (test/support/req462_adoption.ex:41-44), with no on_exit restore. DataCase setup resets shared mode for each non-async test, so the leak should be limited to the loan test's own writes, which are not rolled back. Whether this contributes to the tenant-clone collisions was not tested. ELIXIR-DEV should document why :auto is needed or drop it (restore in on_exit if kept). TEST-DESIGNER should confirm the suite is green under the shared mode.

Escalation residual, confirmed and correctly documented. escalate-disburse-loan-to-credit-director (role-credit-director) does not name l2-approval or committee-vote-director (both role-credit-director). The shipped guard (required_outputs_shipped_definitions_test.exs:149) asserts zero single-member candidate pairs, and single_member_pairs/1 treats any same-role node pair as a candidate, so the REQ-465 description's candidate pairs conflict with the REQ-464 guard. The sole role-credit-director holder can approve at l2-approval and then release via escalate-disburse. This is a BA/ORCH decision (GH #2386). REQ-465 stays in_progress until it is decided. Not a technical failure of this validation.
AC6 (UAT scenarios that would now be refused) rests on ELIXIR-DEV's analysis (refused_scenarios = []). It was not independently re-derived in this run.

Wording drift (REVIEWER step-04 issue 7): the REQ-465 acceptance criteria say the REQ-464 validator 'reports status OK'. The implementation returns valid=true. The BA or ORCH should reword the criterion; it should not be forced.
ceo-override has distinct_from but no refusal test (SECURITY-REVIEWER issue 2, REVIEWER issue 5). Not in the stated acceptance criteria. Recommended, not blocking.

Simulation process copies (test/fixtures/simulation/meridian/process_claim_intake.yaml and process_policy_binding.yaml) lack distinct_from while the QA copies carry it. Recorded drift, not registered (REVIEWER issue 8). Outside this change set by design.
Rollout gap (SECURITY-REVIEWER issue 4): instances created on 1.13 keep their snapshot and no separation rule after the 1.14 activation. The BA or ORCH must accept this or drain in-flight instances.

Test-infrastructure flakes in the full run, same family as ISS-0578 and ISS-0842 (both closed): tenant clone 'tenant_id has already been taken' (DefinitionsTest, MigrationRolloutTest) and a 401 in PlatformScopeNotConferredTest. Each passes in isolation. ORCH should decide whether to file an ISS. I did not file one.

UatPreflightLocalDepsTest fails on this Windows host because the scenario directory scan rejects the c:/Users/... tmp path. The test and script are unchanged by this branch. Needs a Windows-compatible fix, or confirmation that Linux CI passes.

Process notes: (a) HEAD moved from ddefe829 to db0b4fed (REVIEWER handoff only) during this run; code is identical. (b) Another session held the BEAM mutex (mixlock) from 05:45 to 06:13 UTC; I acquired it at 06:13:34 and released it at 07:04:18 with rmdir. (c) The Bash tool moved the first full-suite call to the background at its 600 s cap; I did not background it myself, and I polled in foreground until the 'combined:' line appeared. The harness's 'exit code 0' completion notices reflected a trailing grep, not the runner; the runner's own exits were 1. (d) Free memory fell to about 0.4 GB during run 1 (31.8 GB total); the harness did not kill the run.
